scope: USA ROM SHA-1 97777ca06f4e8aff8f1e95033cc8d3833be40f76. Conventional matching-decompilation project: after one-time extraction, the build compiles, assembles, links and re-encodes without reading the base ROM, then reproduces its SHA-1. Original assembly and the single inline-assembly allocator workaround are source-complete but excluded from ordinary-C credit.
